title: Ron DeSantis’s Rise From Unknown to Heir Apparent

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As the race for the 2024 Republican presidential nomination gets underway.
sentences.zh: 随着2024年共和党总统候选人提名的角逐拉开帷幕。

sentences.en: I'm Nikki Haley and I'm running for president.
sentences.zh: 我是妮基·黑利，我正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: A single figure has so far emerged as a true rival to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 目前出现了一位真正能与唐纳德·特朗普抗衡的人物。

sentences.en: I love DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: Fantastic job.
sentences.zh: 干得漂亮。

sentences.en: I love the guy.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这家伙。

sentences.en: Trump's my president and DeSantis will be my next president.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是我的总统，而德桑蒂斯将是我的下一任总统。

sentences.en: Governor Ron DeSantis of Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: DeSantis leading Trump by double digits, 14 points.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯以两位数的优势领先特朗普，领先14个百分点。

sentences.en: He also hasn't even announced.
sentences.zh: 而且他甚至还没宣布参选。

sentences.en: He may have...
sentences.zh: 他可能已经……

sentences.en: Who poll show has broken away from the pack by turning his state into a laboratory for a post-Trump version of conservatism.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，他通过将自己的州变成后特朗普时代保守主义的实验室，已经从竞争者中脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Has the Apprentice now become the master of the conservative party?
sentences.zh: 那个曾经的“学徒”现在成了保守党的主人了吗？

sentences.en: That's the question.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Now, as DeSantis takes his first steps towards announcing a possible candidacy,
sentences.zh: 现在，随着德桑蒂斯迈出宣布可能参选的第一步，

sentences.en: including a high-profile tour of early voting states and the release of a book about his vision for the country,
sentences.zh: 包括对早期投票州进行高调巡回访问，并出版了一本关于他国家愿景的书，

sentences.en: My colleague, Patti Mazzeh, tells the story of his rapid and unlikely rise to Republican stardom and his potential path to the nomination.
sentences.zh: 我的同事帕蒂·马泽将讲述他迅速且出人意料地崛起为共和党明星的故事，以及他通往提名的潜在路径。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月7日，星期二。

sentences.en: Patti, you have lived in Florida for years now, and you've really had a front-row view of Ron DeSantis' career,
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，你在佛罗里达州住了多年，一直近距离观察着罗恩·德桑蒂斯的职业生涯，

sentences.en: which is why we want to talk to you about how it is that he has become such a powerful force in the Republican Party and in this emerging 2024 race to become the party's presidential nominee,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们要和你聊聊，他是如何成为共和党内的一股强大力量，以及在即将到来的2024年党内总统提名竞选中脱颖而出的，

sentences.en: despite not even being an announced candidate.
sentences.zh: 尽管他甚至还没宣布参选。

sentences.en: So, where in your mind does that story start?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你看来，这个故事是从哪里开始的呢？

sentences.en: So, Ron DeSantis was born in Jacksonville, Florida, and grew up outside of Tampa.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯出生在佛罗里达州的杰克逊维尔，在坦帕郊外长大。

sentences.en: His mother was a nurse.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一名护士。

sentences.en: His dad installed TV ratings boxes for Nielsen, and he played baseball, which eventually took him to Yale, where he also played baseball, and later to Harvard Law School.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲为尼尔森公司安装电视收视率监测盒，他打棒球，这最终让他进入了耶鲁大学，在那里他也打棒球，后来又去了哈佛法学院。

sentences.en: And after graduating from Harvard, he became a lawyer for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从哈佛毕业后，他成为了一名美国海军律师。

sentences.en: Navy.
sentences.zh: 海军。

sentences.en: So, that was his sterling resume when he was elected to Congress in 2012 from a district in Northeast Florida.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是他2012年从佛罗里达州东北部选区当选国会议员时的辉煌履历。

sentences.en: And he was a sort of low-profile, classic Tea Party Republican who ran on cutting spending and shrinking the size of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他当时是一个低调的、典型的茶党共和党人，主张削减开支和缩小联邦政府规模。

sentences.en: And when he was in Congress, he was known for being a guy without many friends, sort of aloof, prickly,
sentences.zh: 在国会期间，他以朋友不多、有些冷漠、难以相处而闻名，

sentences.en: walking around with headphones on his ears so he didn't have to chat with people.
sentences.zh: 总是戴着耳机走来走去，这样就不必和人聊天。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember being a political reporter in this era and not really ever hearing his name.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我记得当时作为一名政治记者，我几乎从未听过他的名字。

sentences.en: So, here you have a kind of Tea Party backbencher at the birth of that movement, not especially memorable or impactful on the party.
sentences.zh: 所以，你看到的只是那个运动诞生时的一个茶党后座议员，在党内并没有特别令人难忘或有影响力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But even then, he had a bit of a provocative style.
sentences.zh: 但即使在那时，他也有点挑衅的风格。

sentences.en: President Obama, as you might recall, had written a best-selling book about his family called Dreams from My Father.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得，奥巴马总统曾写过一本关于他家庭的畅销书，叫《我父亲的梦想》。

sentences.en: Well, DeSantis wrote a sort of retort to it, and he made the case against Obama's policies and titled it Dreams from Our Founding Fathers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德桑蒂斯写了一本算是反驳的书，他列举了反对奥巴马政策的理由，并将其命名为《我们开国元勋的梦想》。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: A book designed to troll the Democratic president.
sentences.zh: 一本旨在嘲讽这位民主党总统的书。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But he really doesn't arrive on the national scene until 2018 when he decides to run for governor of Florida.
sentences.zh: 但他直到2018年决定竞选佛罗里达州州长时，才真正出现在全国舞台上。

sentences.en: And he's not the Republican establishment favorite.
sentences.zh: 而且他并不是共和党建制派的首选。

sentences.en: Everyone knows my husband, Ron DeSantis, is endorsed by President Trump, but he's also an amazing dad.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道我的丈夫罗恩·德桑蒂斯得到了特朗普总统的支持，但他也是一位了不起的父亲。

sentences.en: Ron loves playing with the kids.
sentences.zh: 罗恩喜欢和孩子们玩。

sentences.en: So he introduces himself to the state with this ad that becomes instantly memorable, narrated by his wife, that talks about how her husband plays with their children.
sentences.zh: 于是他通过这则由他妻子旁白、讲述她丈夫如何与孩子玩耍的广告向全州介绍自己，这则广告瞬间让人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Build the wall.
sentences.zh: 筑墙。

sentences.en: And the way he does that in this ad is by building a wall with toy blocks.
sentences.zh: 他在广告中筑墙的方式是用积木搭了一堵墙。

sentences.en: Then Mr. Trump said, you're fired.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普先生说，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: I love that part.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那一部分。

sentences.en: And reading a bedtime story that is Donald Trump's art of the deal.
sentences.zh: 他还读了睡前故事，那是唐纳德·特朗普的《交易的艺术》。

sentences.en: People say Ron's all Trump, but he is so much more.
sentences.zh: 人们说罗恩完全是特朗普那一套，但他远不止于此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember this ad.
sentences.zh: 我记得这则广告。

sentences.en: And what's interesting about it is that it's not just an ode to Donald Trump, who was president at the time, head of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，它不仅仅是对当时担任总统、共和党领袖的唐纳德·特朗普的颂歌，

sentences.en: It simultaneously pokes fun at the very idea of having to make an ode to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 它同时还嘲弄了那种必须向唐纳德·特朗普致敬的想法本身。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It acknowledges how much a Republican at the time needed to tether himself to Trump, but also is kind of in on the joke.
sentences.zh: 它承认了当时的共和党人有多需要依附于特朗普，但同时也带有一种心照不宣的幽默感。

sentences.en: And he really strongly pursues Trump's explicit endorsement, and he gets it.
sentences.zh: 他非常坚定地寻求特朗普的明确背书，并且成功了。

sentences.en: And that endorsement catapults DeSantis to winning the Republican primary and then to winning the general election by less than one percentage point.
sentences.zh: 那次背书让德桑蒂斯赢得了共和党初选，随后又以不到一个百分点的优势赢得了大选。

sentences.en: And he becomes governor just by the slimmest of margins.
sentences.zh: 他以极其微弱的优势当选州长。

sentences.en: And, of course, being a Republican governor in the era of Donald Trump means, to some degree, accepting that he is the big story and the big figure in the party.
sentences.zh: 当然，在唐纳德·特朗普时代担任共和党州长，在某种程度上意味着接受他是党内的大人物和核心焦点。

sentences.en: So, as governor, how does DeSantis end up carving out a space in the spotlight of his own and ultimately become a rival to Trump?
sentences.zh: 那么，作为州长，德桑蒂斯是如何最终开辟出属于自己的聚光灯，并最终成为特朗普的竞争对手的呢？

sentences.en: It really all starts with the coronavirus pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这一切真的始于新冠疫情。

sentences.en: At first, DeSantis really hesitates to lock down the state.
sentences.zh: 起初，德桑蒂斯确实对封锁该州犹豫不决。

sentences.en: He has this instinct against it, but wants to do what the federal government, at the time run by President Trump, is urging states to do.
sentences.zh: 他有反对封锁的直觉，但又想做当时由特朗普总统领导的联邦政府敦促各州去做的事情。

sentences.en: And so he does, in April of 2020, issue a stay-at-home order.
sentences.zh: 所以他在2020年4月发布了居家令。

sentences.en: However, he quickly starts looking for a way to reopen the state.
sentences.zh: 然而，他很快就开始寻找重新开放该州的方法。

sentences.en: By May, the stay-at-home orders start to expire, and he's telling people they should start going about their normal lives again.
sentences.zh: 到了5月，居家令开始到期，他告诉人们应该重新开始正常生活。

sentences.en: We're going to be safe, smart, and we're going to do this step by step.
sentences.zh: 我们将保持安全、明智，并将一步一步地完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And by the fall, he forces schools to reopen by sort of threatening school funding.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，他通过威胁削减学校经费的方式强迫学校重新开放。

sentences.en: Our kids are at the least risk from this virus, yet it is our kids who have borne the harshest burden of the control measures instituted to protect against the virus.
sentences.zh: 我们的孩子受这种病毒的影响风险最小，然而正是我们的孩子承受了为防止病毒而采取的控制措施所带来的最沉重负担。

sentences.en: But he doesn't just say the schools need to reopen.
sentences.zh: 但他不仅仅是说学校需要重新开放。

sentences.en: He goes further.
sentences.zh: 他走得更远。

sentences.en: I'm opposed to mandates, period.
sentences.zh: 我反对强制令，句号。

sentences.en: I don't think they work.
sentences.zh: 我不认为它们有效。

sentences.en: He bans mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 他禁止了口罩强制令。

sentences.en: People in Florida wear them when you go out.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的人们出门时会戴口罩。

sentences.en: I mean, they don't have to be strung up by a bayonet to do it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们不需要被刺刀逼着才去做。

sentences.en: He tells businesses that they can't require people to be vaccinated to come to their shops, to their restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他告诉企业，他们不能要求人们接种疫苗才能进入他们的商店或餐馆。

sentences.en: You can't burn down the village in order to save it.
sentences.zh: 你不能为了拯救村庄而烧毁村庄。

sentences.en: You can't kneecap your own society and think you're going to successfully handle a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 你不能在削弱自己社会的同时，还认为自己能成功应对大流行。

sentences.en: And so there's really no alternative left for businesses and institutions but to reopen and to do so with relatively loose COVID policies.
sentences.zh: 因此，企业和机构除了重新开放并采取相对宽松的防疫政策外，真的别无选择。

sentences.en: Right, so he's using the power of the governorship to basically make it impossible to do anything other than fully reopen.
sentences.zh: 没错，所以他利用州长的权力，基本上让除了全面重新开放之外的任何事情都变得不可能。

sentences.en: He's taken all the available systematic precautions and basically made them illegal.
sentences.zh: 他采取了所有可用的系统性预防措施，并基本上使它们变得非法。

sentences.en: Yes, and he's incredibly vocal about it at every step.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且他在每一步都对此直言不讳。

sentences.en: The lie of the lockdown was if you just lock down, then you can beat the virus.
sentences.zh: 封锁的谎言在于，如果你只是封锁，那么你就能战胜病毒。

sentences.en: Why are people having the lockdown two or three times then?
sentences.zh: 那为什么人们还要封锁两三次呢？

sentences.en: He juxtaposes himself with blue state governors all the time.
sentences.zh: 他总是将自己与蓝州的州长们进行对比。

sentences.en: I mean, just look with New York.
sentences.zh: 我是说，看看纽约就知道了。

sentences.en: If your positivity is above whatever arbitrary thing, you have to close the school.
sentences.zh: 如果你的阳性率高于任何武断的数字，你就必须关闭学校。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Comparing himself to New York, California.
sentences.zh: 他拿自己与纽约、加州进行比较。

sentences.en: In the state of Florida, we probably are the most open big state in the country.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州，我们可能是全国最开放的大州。

sentences.en: I mean, if you look...
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果你看看……

sentences.en: He realizes that there is a lot of anger towards those policies and begins to capitalize on that.
sentences.zh: 他意识到人们对这些政策有很多愤怒，并开始利用这一点。

sentences.en: So some of this stuff I think is petty tyranny.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为其中一些东西是琐碎的暴政。

sentences.en: I think it's been a huge mistake.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个巨大的错误。

sentences.en: So he starts becoming the figure that represents anger, chafing, opposition to a lot of the more restrictive COVID policies from 2020.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始成为代表愤怒、不满和反对2020年许多更严格防疫政策的人物。

sentences.en: What's interesting about this moment, and I remember it really well, is how it made DeSantis a kind of hero to those who wanted to break free from these pandemic restrictions,
sentences.zh: 这个时刻有趣的地方在于，我记得非常清楚，它让德桑蒂斯成为了那些想要摆脱这些大流行限制的人心目中的英雄，

sentences.en: even though it was President Trump who, by this point, was calling for the nation's governors to end the lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时正是特朗普总统在呼吁全国各州州长结束封锁。

sentences.en: But Trump, despite his own skepticism of the COVID rules, was in this tricky position because he's still the face of that original federal response to the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 但特朗普尽管自己对防疫规则持怀疑态度，却处于一个棘手的境地，因为他仍然是联邦政府最初应对大流行政策的代言人，

sentences.en: which is lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 也就是封锁。

sentences.en: So for many, DeSantis becomes a kind of pure version of anti-lockdown leadership.
sentences.zh: 因此对许多人来说，德桑蒂斯成为了一种纯粹的反封锁领导力的版本。

sentences.en: I think that's true, that Trump couldn't really be in the position of both defending his administration's policies and advice and then countering them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是真的，特朗普无法真正处于既要捍卫自己政府的政策和建议，又要反驳它们的立场。

sentences.en: But DeSantis could be.
sentences.zh: 但德桑蒂斯可以。

sentences.en: And that helps him build this persona of trying to go back to what he believes is common sense, put our kids in school, let people go back to work.
sentences.zh: 这有助于他建立起一种试图回归他所认为的常识的人设：让我们的孩子上学，让人们回去工作。

sentences.en: And Patty, when it comes to the pandemic, is it possible to say whether or not this approach he took worked?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，说到大流行，是否可以说他采取的这种方法是否奏效了？

sentences.en: I think DeSantis gambled that people would hold their government officials accountable more for policies like lockdowns than they would for deaths caused by a global pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我认为德桑蒂斯赌的是，人们会因为像封锁这样的政策而追究政府官员的责任，而不是因为全球大流行导致的死亡。

sentences.en: More than 86,000 Floridians have died from the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 超过86,000名佛罗里达人死于新冠病毒。

sentences.en: But in the end, public opinion polling and election results show that people rewarded DeSantis for the policies that he endorsed to reopen the economy.
sentences.zh: 但最终，民意调查和选举结果显示，人们因为他支持重新开放经济的政策而奖励了德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And what's the lesson that you think DeSantis took from this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 你认为德桑蒂斯从这次大流行中学到了什么教训？

sentences.en: He seemed to have learned that if you came off as a fighter who was always on the offense picking fights against the overarching liberal elite, that you would be rewarded,
sentences.zh: 他似乎学到，如果你表现得像一个总是处于进攻状态、不断向主流自由派精英发起挑战的斗士，你就会得到回报，

sentences.en: that that would pay off, that you would get national attention and popularity from your base, from the right, and that it could only help you to do more of that rather than less.
sentences.zh: 这会带来回报，你会从你的基本盘、从右翼那里获得全国性的关注和人气，而且多做这些事而不是少做，只会对你有帮助。

sentences.en: So where does he start to do more of that?
sentences.zh: 那么他从哪里开始做更多这类事情的呢？

sentences.en: He starts picking new fights unrelated to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他开始挑选与大流行无关的新争端。

sentences.en: And the biggest one, the one that probably got the most attention in Florida and the rest of the country, is against one of the states and the country's most beloved companies,
sentences.zh: 其中最大的一场，可能是在佛罗里达州和全国引起最多关注的一场，是针对该州乃至全国最受喜爱的公司之一，

sentences.en: Disney.
sentences.zh: 迪士尼。

sentences.en: And remind us what he does with Disney.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下他对迪士尼做了什么。

sentences.en: Well, in early 2022.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在2022年初。

sentences.en: We are taking a deeper dive into a proposed law that is dividing parents here in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我们正在深入探讨一项正在佛罗里达州家长中引起分歧的拟议法律。

sentences.en: A bill starts going through the Florida legislature that restricts the way sexual orientation and gender identity can be taught in schools.
sentences.zh: 一项法案开始在佛罗里达州立法机构通过，限制在学校教授性取向和性别认同的方式。

sentences.en: It would ban schools from teaching about sexual orientation or gender identity to younger students between kindergarten and third grade.
sentences.zh: 它将禁止学校向幼儿园到三年级的低年级学生教授有关性取向或性别认同的内容。

sentences.en: And opponents nicknamed this legislation, which is formerly called Parental Rights in Education, the Don't Say Gay Bill.
sentences.zh: 反对者给这项正式名称为《教育中的父母权利》的立法起了个绰号，叫“不准说同性恋法案”。

sentences.en: We say gay!
sentences.zh: 我们要说同性恋！

sentences.en: We say gay!
sentences.zh: 我们要说同性恋！

sentences.en: They start trying to rally public opinion against it, including among businesses.
sentences.zh: 他们开始试图动员公众舆论反对它，包括在企业界。

sentences.en: Dozens of Disney employees walked off the job, an act of protest over Florida's so-called Don't Say Gay Bill.
sentences.zh: 数十名迪士尼员工罢工，抗议佛罗里达州所谓的“不准说同性恋法案”。

sentences.en: And eventually, word comes out that Disney opposes the bill.
sentences.zh: 最终，有消息传出迪士尼反对该法案。

sentences.en: Which is a big deal because Disney, as you just indicated, is a major player and employer in Florida.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事，因为正如你刚才指出的，迪士尼是佛罗里达州的主要参与者和雇主。

sentences.en: And in Florida politics, Disney has usually gotten what it wants.
sentences.zh: 在佛罗里达州的政治中，迪士尼通常都能如愿以偿。

sentences.en: But in this case, DeSantis criticizes Disney.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，德桑蒂斯批评了迪士尼。

sentences.en: You know, when we were young, you could watch cartoons without having to worry.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们年轻的时候，你可以看动画片而不必担心。

sentences.en: Now parents have to sit there and worry about what are they trying to inject in?
sentences.zh: 现在家长们必须坐在那里担心他们试图灌输什么？

sentences.en: What type of ideology are they trying to pursue?
sentences.zh: 他们试图追求什么样的意识形态？

sentences.en: And that is wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是错误的。

sentences.en: Which is sort of unheard of in Republican political circles in this state,
sentences.zh: 这在该州的共和党政治圈中是闻所未闻的，

sentences.en: especially for the governor to pick a sort of high-profile fight with a company that has just been such a big player.
sentences.zh: 尤其是州长与一家一直以来都是如此重要参与者的公司进行这种高调的斗争。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And whose emblem is Mickey Mouse?
sentences.zh: 而且其标志是米老鼠？

sentences.en: Who picks a fight with Mickey Mouse?
sentences.zh: 谁会去和米老鼠打架？

sentences.en: Nobody.
sentences.zh: 没人会。

sentences.en: Until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在。

sentences.en: But the reason you see things like these, these kerfluffles, is because of something that is effectively a woke mind virus that's getting involved into all these institutions.
sentences.zh: 但你之所以看到像这样的骚乱，是因为某种实际上是“觉醒思想病毒”的东西正在介入所有这些机构。

sentences.en: He says that the government, or that his administration anyway, is not going to fall victim to what he describes as a woke ideology.
sentences.zh: 他说政府，或者至少是他的政府，绝不会成为他所称的“觉醒”意识形态的受害者。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm going to do what's right for the people of Florida.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我要为佛罗里达人民做正确的事。

sentences.en: I don't take marching orders from woke corporations based in California.
sentences.zh: 我不会听命于总部设在加州的“觉醒”企业。

sentences.en: That's not how I roll.
sentences.zh: 我行事不看他们的脸色。

sentences.en: And he even goes as far as to threaten Disney's bottom line.
sentences.zh: 他甚至扬言要打击迪士尼的利润底线。

sentences.en: So they're free to take these positions, but they are not free to force us to subsidize their activism.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可以自由地持有这些立场，但他们无权强迫我们去资助他们的激进主义。

sentences.en: And they've been getting massive subsidies from Florida since before I was born.
sentences.zh: 而且他们从我出生前就开始从佛罗里达州获得巨额补贴了。

sentences.en: All because Disney had the temerity to oppose this bill about talking about sexuality in schools.
sentences.zh: 这一切仅仅是因为迪士尼竟敢反对这项关于在学校讨论性取向的法案。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 而且奏效了。

sentences.en: Surrounded by young students at a Pasco County charter school, Governor Ron DeSantis signed the Parental Rights in Education Bill.
sentences.zh: 在帕斯科县一所特许学校被学生们簇拥着，罗恩·德桑蒂斯州长签署了《父母教育权利法案》。

sentences.en: He signed the Parental Rights in Education Bill after it was passed by the state legislature.
sentences.zh: 在该法案由州议会通过后，他签署了《父母教育权利法案》。

sentences.en: And then he also signed another bill that did, in fact, target Disney.
sentences.zh: 随后，他又签署了另一项实际上针对迪士尼的法案。

sentences.en: The company will now be under the control of a state board and has been ordered to pay back $700 million in debt and taxes.
sentences.zh: 该公司现在将置于州委员会的控制之下，并被勒令偿还7亿美元的债务和税款。

sentences.en: Today, the corporate kingdom finally comes to an end.
sentences.zh: 今天，这个企业王国终于走到了尽头。

sentences.en: People started praising DeSantis and siding with DeSantis for taking on Disney.
sentences.zh: 人们开始称赞德桑蒂斯，并支持他对抗迪士尼。

sentences.en: And he becomes this culture warrior who can now go around the state and the country saying, we took on the biggest corporation in the state.
sentences.zh: 他成为了那种可以在全州乃至全国到处宣扬的“文化斗士”，声称我们对抗了州内最大的企业。

sentences.en: We can take on any other corporation, any other institution, any other elite that comes our way.
sentences.zh: 我们也能对抗任何其他企业、任何其他机构、任何挡在我们面前的精英。

sentences.en: Beware.
sentences.zh: 小心了。

sentences.en: There's a new sheriff in town and accountability will be the order of the day.
sentences.zh: 镇上来了一位新警长，问责制将成为当务之急。

sentences.en: And, of course, as this Disney fight is playing out and DeSantis is reaping the political dividends from it on the right,
sentences.zh: 当然，随着这场迪士尼之争的展开，德桑蒂斯在右翼阵营中收获了政治红利，

sentences.en: something else is happening, which is that Donald Trump's star is rapidly fading,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，另一件事正在发生，那就是唐纳德·特朗普的声望正在迅速下滑，

sentences.en: mostly over January 6th and all these damning revelations that have come out of the hearings of the January 6th committee about his decision making,
sentences.zh: 这主要是因为1月6日事件，以及1月6日委员会听证会上披露的关于他决策过程的种种令人震惊的内幕，

sentences.en: all of which start to cast real doubt on Trump's appeal and really his hold over the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都开始让人们真正怀疑特朗普的号召力，以及他对比共和党的掌控力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The 2022 midterm election becomes a public test for both Trump and DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 2022年中期选举成了对特朗普和德桑蒂斯的共同考验。

sentences.en: Trump is campaigning for candidates who support his election denialism while dealing with the January 6th investigation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在为支持他“选举舞弊论”的候选人竞选，同时还要应对1月6日事件的调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: DeSantis is campaigning for his fellow Republicans but not talking about election denialism.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯在为共和党同僚竞选，但绝口不提“选举舞弊论”。

sentences.en: He says the elections in Florida are properly run.
sentences.zh: 他说佛罗里达州的选举运行良好。

sentences.en: He still opens an office of election crimes to investigate potential fraud.
sentences.zh: 但他还是设立了一个选举犯罪办公室来调查潜在的欺诈行为。

sentences.en: But he is really running on these fights that he has taken on in the state and won and that his political base really likes.
sentences.zh: 但他真正竞选的筹码是他已经在州内发起并获胜的那些斗争，而他的政治基本盘非常喜欢这些。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Pandemic, Disney.
sentences.zh: 疫情，迪士尼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And on election day, he wins in a landslide.
sentences.zh: 选举日当天，他以压倒性优势获胜。

sentences.en: He wins by 19 percentage points in a state where recent elections had been decided by maybe one or two percentage points.
sentences.zh: 他在一个近期选举胜负差距仅在一两个百分点的州，以19个百分点的优势获胜。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So a very different situation than four years earlier in 2018 when DeSantis barely squeaked out a victory.
sentences.zh: 所以这与四年前的2018年情况大不相同，当时德桑蒂斯只是勉强获胜。

sentences.en: This time, he's clearly won over a lot more voters with this elbows out aggressive approach.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他显然通过这种强硬的进攻姿态赢得了更多选民的支持。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, Trump has one of the worst days that he has politically because his candidates do horribly elsewhere in the country.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特朗普遭遇了他在政治上最糟糕的日子之一，因为他的候选人在全国其他地方表现惨淡。

sentences.en: Their paths sort of cross in opposite directions.
sentences.zh: 他们的轨迹在某种程度上朝着相反的方向交错。

sentences.en: Trump is starting to look weaker and DeSantis is starting to look stronger.
sentences.zh: 特朗普看起来越来越弱，而德桑蒂斯看起来越来越强。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Patty, as Trump's fortunes are falling, what does DeSantis do with this landslide victory he has in Florida?
sentences.zh: 那么，帕蒂，随着特朗普的运势下滑，德桑蒂斯将如何利用他在佛罗里达州的这场压倒性胜利？

sentences.en: DeSantis is now emboldened.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯现在底气更足了。

sentences.en: He has super majorities in both chambers of the state legislature.
sentences.zh: 他在州议会两院都拥有绝对多数席位。

sentences.en: He's got the support of local officials all the way down to school board members that he has helped get elected.
sentences.zh: 他得到了从地方官员到他帮助选出的校董会成员的支持。

sentences.en: And so he unleashes his playbook and is putting it into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 于是他释放了他的策略，并将其推向了极致。

sentences.en: Florida is where Wolfe goes.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达就是沃尔夫（Wolfe）要去的地方。

sentences.en: And just weeks into his second term, the administration has a new target.
sentences.zh: 在他第二个任期开始仅几周后，政府就有了新的目标。

sentences.en: Just over the past few weeks, we've seen how he has attacked New College, which is a public liberal arts institution in Sarasota.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几周，我们看到了他是如何攻击新学院（New College）的，那是一所位于萨拉索塔的公立文理学院。

sentences.en: Governor Ron DeSantis recently replaced six of the board's 13 members in an apparent bid to transform this intimate 700-person liberal arts college.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯州长最近撤换了该校董事会13名成员中的6名，显然是为了改造这所仅有700人的小型文理学院。

sentences.en: He and his allies want to turn into a beacon of conservatism as a fight against liberal academia.
sentences.zh: 他和他的盟友想把它变成保守主义的灯塔，作为对抗自由派学术界的阵地。

sentences.en: So the mission has been, I think, more into the DEI, CRT, the gender ideology, rather than what a liberal arts education should be.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，他们的使命更多是针对DEI（多元、公平、包容）、CRT（批判性种族理论）和性别意识形态，而不是文理教育本身。

sentences.en: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is defending his administration's decision to block a course on African-American studies from the state's public schools.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯正在为他政府阻止公立学校开设非裔美国人研究课程的决定进行辩护。

sentences.en: He has rejected an advanced placement African-American studies course for high schoolers.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了为高中生开设的非裔美国人研究先修课程。

sentences.en: Who would say that an important part of black history is queer theory?
sentences.zh: 谁会说黑人历史的重要组成部分是酷儿理论？

sentences.en: That is somebody pushing an agenda on our kids.
sentences.zh: 那是有人在向我们的孩子推行某种议程。

sentences.en: It's our view in Florida that we want to be standing up for the little guy against some of these massive media conglomerates.
sentences.zh: 我们在佛罗里达州的观点是，我们要为小人物挺身而出，对抗那些庞大的媒体集团。

sentences.en: He has convened a roundtable looking like he's a cable news anchor where he has talked about how the news media has way too much power and it has to be easier to sue them for libel and defamation.
sentences.zh: 他召集了一场圆桌会议，看起来就像个有线电视新闻主播，他谈到新闻媒体权力过大，必须更容易起诉他们诽谤和中伤。

sentences.en: And I have only begun to fight.
sentences.zh: 而且我的战斗才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: So, time after time, we are seeing him announce, endorse,
sentences.zh: 所以，我们一次又一次地看到他宣布、背书、

sentences.en: propose policies that the legislature can pass in the coming weeks and add to his list of fights and victories that then he can campaign on.
sentences.zh: 提出议案，让议会在未来几周内通过，并增加他的斗争和胜利清单，然后他就可以以此进行竞选。

sentences.en: And all that's just in the past few weeks, you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是说这些都是在过去几周内发生的？

sentences.en: It makes it hard to keep up.
sentences.zh: 这让人很难跟上节奏。

sentences.en: So, in each of these cases,
sentences.zh: 所以，在每一个案例中，

sentences.en: the common theme here of a line of attack is that liberal elites have infiltrated an institution and he is going to be the savior who swoops in and stops them.
sentences.zh: 这里攻击路线的共同主题是，自由派精英已经渗透到了某个机构，而他将成为那个冲进来阻止他们的救世主。

sentences.en: And it almost doesn't really matter whether the facts he's claiming are true.
sentences.zh: 而且他所声称的事实是否属实几乎无关紧要。

sentences.en: He's very compellingly, to those on the right, making the case that he has ferreted out a problem that must be solved.
sentences.zh: 对于右翼人士来说，他非常有说服力地证明了他已经揪出了一个必须解决的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's again seizing on this anger that people have and maybe used to have sort of privately about how far some institutions have gone in changing.
sentences.zh: 他再次抓住了人们心中的愤怒，这种愤怒可能过去只是私下里对某些机构变化过大而产生的不满。

sentences.en: And so he's capitalizing on that.
sentences.zh: 所以他正在利用这一点。

sentences.en: And, of course, everything about this feels Trumpian, but Trump is no longer in office.
sentences.zh: 当然，这一切听起来都很有“特朗普风格”，但特朗普已经不在任了。

sentences.en: No, Trump is a resident of Florida, but he spends most of his time, you know, at Mar-a-Lago where he's dealing with multiple lawsuits and scandals.
sentences.zh: 不，特朗普是佛罗里达州的居民，但他大部分时间都待在海湖庄园，在那里处理多起诉讼和丑闻。

sentences.en: And DeSantis is the one getting the attention.
sentences.zh: 而德桑蒂斯才是那个备受关注的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, from the best we can tell, upsetting Trump that he is doing so.
sentences.zh: 而且据我们所知，这让特朗普感到不安。

sentences.en: Well, explain that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, what our colleagues have reported is that Trump sees DeSantis as a very clear threat, as somebody who could potentially challenge him in a Republican primary.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事报道说，特朗普将德桑蒂斯视为一个非常明显的威胁，认为他可能在共和党初选中挑战自己。

sentences.en: And so he has taken to publicly calling him Ron DeSantis, and we understand privately calling him Meatball Ron.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始公开称呼他为“罗恩·德桑蒂斯”，据我们了解，私下里称他为“肉丸罗恩”。

sentences.en: And DeSantis so far has managed to not take the bait and said that he, you know, doesn't spend his time smearing or taking pot shots at other Republicans.
sentences.zh: 而德桑蒂斯到目前为止设法没有上钩，并表示他不会把时间花在诋毁或攻击其他共和党人身上。

sentences.en: But there's no sure sign that Donald Trump feels threatened or rivaled by somebody than when he gives that person a nasty nickname.
sentences.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普感到受到威胁或竞争时，最明显的信号就是他给那个人起个难听的绰号。

sentences.en: And if he's given Ron DeSantis multiple nasty nicknames, then you know he's feeling threatened.
sentences.zh: 如果他给罗恩·德桑蒂斯起了好几个难听的绰号，那你就能看出他感到威胁了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And DeSantis is doing nothing to dissuade the idea that he might be interested in running for president.
sentences.zh: 而且德桑蒂斯并没有做任何事情来打消人们认为他有兴趣竞选总统的念头。

sentences.en: In fact, he's making overt gestures that suggest that he is interested in running for president.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他正在做出明显的姿态，暗示他有兴趣竞选总统。

sentences.en: He has been taking trips to other states, states that are important in presidential elections, Pennsylvania, New York.
sentences.zh: 他一直在前往其他州，那些在总统选举中很重要的州，比如宾夕法尼亚州、纽约州。

sentences.en: He has put out a new book.
sentences.zh: 他出版了一本新书。

sentences.en: He has welcomed political donors, and tell me if this sounds familiar, to a hotel in Palm Beach to talk about his politics.
sentences.zh: 他欢迎政治捐款人——如果这听起来很耳熟的话——到棕榈滩的一家酒店谈论他的政治主张。

sentences.en: So these are all the moves of a person who is testing the waters for a potential national campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是一个正在为潜在的全国性竞选试水的人的举动。

sentences.en: And these are definitely the moves of someone who once needed Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 这些绝对是一个曾经需要特朗普的人的举动，对吧？

sentences.en: Needed him so much that he featured himself reading from Trump's book to introduce himself to Florida.
sentences.zh: 需要他到甚至在向佛罗里达介绍自己时，还要特意展示自己在读特朗普的书。

sentences.en: And so in thinking about the totality of what we've covered here, right?
sentences.zh: 那么在思考我们所涵盖的全部内容时，对吧？

sentences.en: And what DeSantis now represents if and when he enters that primary, what portrait of leadership do you think Ron DeSantis, the Republican presidential candidate,
sentences.zh: 如果德桑蒂斯参加初选，他现在代表了什么，你认为罗恩·德桑蒂斯作为共和党总统候选人，

sentences.en: is going to be offering the party?
sentences.zh: 会为党提供什么样的领导形象？

sentences.en: He has positioned himself to campaign as Trump without Trump's baggage.
sentences.zh: 他将自己定位为“没有特朗普包袱的特朗普”。

sentences.en: Trumpism that gets things done but doesn't have scandal and drama.
sentences.zh: 那种能办成事，但没有丑闻和闹剧的“特朗普主义”。

sentences.en: And he's also just a whole lot younger than Trump at 44.
sentences.zh: 而且他才44岁，比特朗普年轻得多。

sentences.en: So he's a fighter from the next generation that can fight for the people who are angry about where society is going and knows how to get stuff passed,
sentences.zh: 所以他是下一代的斗士，能为那些对社会走向感到愤怒的人而战，并且知道如何通过法案，

sentences.en: knows how to use power to do so.
sentences.zh: 知道如何利用权力来做到这一点。

sentences.en: But that style of leadership means that you don't hear from opponents.
sentences.zh: 但那种领导风格意味着你听不到反对者的声音。

sentences.en: It means that people who don't serve your purpose are often ignored.
sentences.zh: 这意味着那些对你没有用处的人经常被忽视。

sentences.en: Or crushed.
sentences.zh: 或者被碾压。

sentences.en: Or crushed.
sentences.zh: 或者被碾压。

sentences.en: It definitely sends a chilling effect.
sentences.zh: 这绝对会产生一种寒蝉效应。

sentences.en: You lead by dividing and pitting groups against each other.
sentences.zh: 你的领导方式是制造分裂，让群体之间相互对立。

sentences.en: In many cases by going after people who are vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下，是通过攻击弱势群体。

sentences.en: And so there's a real downside that critics point to, to how DeSantis has governed, to the people who are not in his favor, who do not agree with him,
sentences.zh: 所以批评者指出，德桑蒂斯的治理方式存在真正的负面影响，对于那些不被他青睐、不同意他的人来说，

sentences.en: having no say in what is happening in the state.
sentences.zh: 在州内发生的事情上根本没有发言权。

sentences.en: But if you are a Republican and you like what DeSantis is doing in Florida, he has created a laboratory for challenging liberalism, for putting into effect right-wing policies.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是共和党人，并且喜欢德桑蒂斯在佛罗里达州的所作所为，他已经建立了一个挑战自由主义、实施右翼政策的实验室。

sentences.en: And that is what he appears to be using as a potential national platform to run for president.
sentences.zh: 而这似乎正是他作为竞选总统的潜在全国性平台。

sentences.en: But the question is, is that enough?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这足够吗？

sentences.en: The fact that he doesn't have Trump's personality is what some people think could be DeSantis' weakness.
sentences.zh: 他没有特朗普那种个性，这被一些人认为是德桑蒂斯的弱点。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: He doesn't have Trump's charisma.
sentences.zh: 他没有特朗普的个人魅力。

sentences.en: He has not been tested at the national stage.
sentences.zh: 他还没有在全国舞台上接受过考验。

sentences.en: And he doesn't really relish firing up crowds.
sentences.zh: 而且他并不真正热衷于煽动人群。

sentences.en: And that's how Donald Trump won the Republican primary in 2016.
sentences.zh: 而这正是唐纳德·特朗普在2016年赢得共和党初选的方式。

sentences.en: So can Ron DeSantis do that without those skills?
sentences.zh: 那么罗恩·德桑蒂斯能在没有这些技能的情况下做到这一点吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's one thing to fight Disney or fight COVID restrictions.
sentences.zh: 对抗迪士尼或对抗新冠限制是一回事。

sentences.en: But if DeSantis runs, he will be up against the man who literally wrote the playbook from which DeSantis has been borrowing.
sentences.zh: 但如果德桑蒂斯参选，他将面对那个亲手写下德桑蒂斯一直在借用的那套剧本的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, DeSantis has been perfecting a version of Trumpism in Florida.
sentences.zh: 是的，德桑蒂斯一直在佛罗里达完善一种“特朗普主义”。

sentences.en: But if he runs for president, he's going to actually have to face Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 但如果他竞选总统，他将不得不面对特朗普本人。

sentences.en: And that, I think, is a much harder political fight than DeSantis has faced before.
sentences.zh: 我认为，那将比德桑蒂斯之前面临的任何政治斗争都要艰难得多。

sentences.en: Well, Patty, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，帕蒂，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Later today, the Florida legislature will reconvene for its latest session, during which its Republican majorities are expected to pass several high-profile bills,
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，佛罗里达州议会将重新召开最新一届会议，预计其共和党多数派将通过几项高调法案，

sentences.en: backed by Governor DeSantis, that target the political left.
sentences.zh: 在德桑蒂斯州长的支持下，这些法案旨在针对政治左派。

sentences.en: One of them is a higher education bill that would ban gender studies majors,
sentences.zh: 其中之一是高等教育法案，该法案将禁止性别研究专业，

sentences.en: prohibit public colleges and universities from spending money on programs espousing diversity, equity, and inclusion, and make it easier to push out tenured faculty members.
sentences.zh: 禁止公立学院和大学在宣扬多元、公平和包容的项目上花钱，并使解雇终身教职人员变得更容易。

sentences.en: People look at Florida, they're like, man, the governor's gotten a lot done, and we have, and we're proud of it.
sentences.zh: 人们看着佛罗里达，他们会说，天哪，州长做了很多事，我们确实做了，我们为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: You ain't seen nothing yet.
sentences.zh: 好戏还在后头呢。

sentences.en: This is going to be the most productive legislative session we have had across the board, and I think people are going to be really excited.
sentences.zh: 这将是我们全面开展的最富有成效的立法会议，我认为人们会感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, Norfolk Southern, which operates the freight train that derailed in East Palestine, Ohio, said it would install about 200 heat detectors on its rail network
sentences.zh: 周一，运营在俄亥俄州东巴勒斯坦脱轨货运列车的诺福克南方铁路公司表示，将在其铁路网络上安装约200个热探测器，

sentences.en: in order to detect the kind of overheating wheel bearing that contributed to the accident.
sentences.zh: 以探测导致事故的那种车轮轴承过热问题。

sentences.en: The technology will be added wherever the distance between existing detectors is more than 15 miles,
sentences.zh: 这项技术将被添加到现有探测器间距超过15英里的地方，

sentences.en: including the approach to East Palestine, where there's a 19-mile gap between detectors.
sentences.zh: 包括通往东巴勒斯坦的线路，那里的探测器之间有19英里的缺口。

sentences.en: The announcement comes just days before Norfolk Southern's CEO is scheduled to testify before Congress about the company's safety record.
sentences.zh: 这一声明发布之际，距离诺福克南方公司首席执行官计划在国会就公司安全记录作证仅有几天时间。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration is considering whether to carry out a mass vaccination of chickens
sentences.zh: 拜登政府正在考虑是否对鸡群进行大规模疫苗接种，

sentences.en: in an effort to stop an outbreak of avian influenza that has already killed tens of millions of birds and, as a result, driven up the cost of eggs.
sentences.zh: 以努力阻止禽流感的爆发，这种流感已经导致数千万只鸟类死亡，并因此推高了鸡蛋的价格。

sentences.en: The bird flu outbreak, which began last year, is the biggest in U.S.
sentences.zh: 始于去年的禽流感疫情是美国历史上规模最大的一次，

sentences.en: history, affecting more than 58 million birds in 47 states.
sentences.zh: 影响了47个州的超过5800万只鸟类。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Astha Chatharvedi, Mary Wilson, and Mujedi, with help from Carlos Prieto.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Astha Chatharvedi、Mary Wilson和Mujedi制作，Carlos Prieto提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 由Rachel Quester和Paige Cowett编辑。

sentences.en: Fact Checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 事实核查由Susan Lee完成，包含Marian Lozano和Dan Powell的原创音乐，由Chris Wood进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的 Jim Brunberg 和 Ben Landsberg 创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Diane Wong and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢 Diane Wong 和 Dan Powell。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是 Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter 秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关事宜。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们睡觉时需要完全遮光吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有过敏或饮食禁忌？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter 秀》。
